symptom: `describe microflow OpenAIConnector.EmbeddingsRequestMapping_POST` (GenAI Showcase 11.12.0; marketplace 220472) printed the decision 'api key type?' as `if OpenAIConnector.Rule_Configuration_KeyTypeToUse(Configuration = $Configuration) then end if;` with empty branches and an orphan `merge shared1;` — check refused it (MDL-FLOW02 "Every merge needs at least one incoming path"). Re-creating it also drifted layout: three @curve lines and one @anchor(from: top) were lost.
cause: The decision is a RuleSplitCondition whose rule returns an enumeration (flows Bearer_Token / API_key / (empty)). enumSplitVariable only recognised an ExpressionSplitCondition `$var`, so the split fell through to the boolean-if emitter, which found no true/false flows; and `case` accepted only a variable or attribute path, so MDL had no form for it. The drift had two other causes: the split builders (if, case, split type) applied a statement's annotations with applyAnnotations, which never records @curve for applyFlowCurves (only applyPendingAnnotations does); and an if's `@anchor(from:)` is the exit side of its closing merge (#767), which has nowhere to land once that merge is declared on its own as `merge shared1;`.
file: mdl/grammar/domains/MDLMicroflow.g4 (enumSplitSource | functionCall); mdl/visitor/visitor_microflow_statements.go; mdl/ast EnumSplitStmt.Condition; mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_actions.go (addEnumSplit via buildSplitCondition; applyPendingAnnotations at split sites); cmd_microflows_builder_rule_case.go (coverage against the rule's return enumeration, exec and check -p); cmd_microflows_show_helpers.go (enumSplitSource); cmd_microflows_show_merge.go (merge declaration carries its exit side)
insight: The repro is downloadable: `mxcli marketplace download 220472` and unzip project.mpr; a whole-module .mpk checks at 650 errors (missing GenAICommons/Atlas) both before and after, so prove mx acceptance in a blank app of the same version instead (11.12.5: 0 errors) and diff the module's error SET for 'unchanged'. GetPut ('Unchanged microflow') hides layout loss — the stored geometry is carried — so the drift only shows on drop + create + re-describe. A rule's return type is on microflows.Rule.ReturnType (EnumerationType); with it, a missing branch is the CE0079 mxbuild reports (measured: forced fault -> 1x CE0079 'The 'API_key' condition value should be configured…'). The labelled-merge exit anchor and the split curves are general, not rule-specific: an `if` and a plain `case $Color` lost them too.
